## 📦 Installation

### NuGet Package Manager
```bash
dotnet add package XTinyLog --version {version}
```

### Package Manager Console
```powershell
PM> Install-Package XTinyLog -Version {version}
```

### PackageReference
```xml
<PackageReference Include="XTinyLog" Version="{version}" />
```
